examples.input:
Which of these tools or techniques are commonly used to characterize adsorption sites experimentally?

Options:
1. Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM)
2. Low-Energy Electron Diffraction (LEED)
3. X-ray Diffraction (XRD) of bulk crystals
4. UV-Vis Spectroscopy
